conditions.scope: boot directly into selected published level; one warmup reload then three measured reloads of that level; no visits to other levels
conditions.inputs: none; idle puzzle and companion update normally
conditions.quality: normal engine; shadows 2048, bloom and all four compositor passes; no gl.finish
conditions.cadence: rAF timestamps of callbacks that executed game.update and engine.render; not capped game dt
conditions.frameCpu: game.update entry through engine.render return; includes UI/effects and probe overhead, not GPU completion
conditions.renderCpu: synchronous engine.render call; not GPU time
conditions.load: level:loading to level:loaded; includes procedural build and engine preparation, not isolated module/build/compile timings
conditions.uiReleasedRender: first synchronous render return after boot overlay removed and transition curtain fully gone; submission proxy, not GPU presentation
conditions.heap: CDP collectGarbage + Runtime.getHeapUsage between load and temporal warmup; JS heap, not VRAM/process memory
conditions.limitations: headless Chromium on SwiftShader is a CI reference, not physical GPU/mobile performance or a complete gameplay workload
